preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The number of integers N in each test case is between 3 and 1000, inclusive.
Each integer A_i in the array is between 0 and 10^9, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 2000
preconditions.description: The total number of integers across all test cases does not exceed 2000.

postconditions.expression: output == 'NO' or (output == 'YES' and B and C)
postconditions.description: The output is either 'NO' if no such permutations exist, or 'YES' followed by two lines of N integers each representing B and C.
If 'YES' is output, there must exist permutations B and C such that no subarray B[i:j] is equal to any subarray C[i:j] for 1 ≤ i ≤ j ≤ N and (i, j) ≠ (1, N).
If 'YES' is output, B must be a permutation of the input array A with all elements unique.
If 'YES' is output, C must be a permutation of the input array A with all elements unique.

postconditions.expression: not any(B[i:j] == C[i:j] for i != 1 or j != N)
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is output, no subarray B[i:j] should equal any subarray C[i:j] except for the entire array which is not considered a subarray of itself.
